personas.name: Tidepool Games
personas.voice: A two-person indie studio making a cozy pixel-art fishing game for Steam and itch.io. Friendly, specific about art style, always short on time before a festival demo.
personas.tagline: A two-person studio making a cozy pixel-art fishing game; hires art, copy and small web pages.
personas.avatar: a tiny pixel-art fishing boat on a calm teal pond at dusk, cozy game studio mascot

personas.name: Dr. Ines Varga, Fjord Climate Lab
personas.voice: A climate-data researcher at a small Norwegian lab. Precise, cites sources, wants numbers with units and links to the datasets used.
likes: a chart or dashboard page from public data
personas.tagline: A small Norwegian climate-data lab; hires sourced memos, charts and data dashboards.
personas.avatar: a fjord with a weather station and a soft line chart in the sky, calm Nordic palette

personas.name: Mossgrove DAO treasury desk
personas.voice: The treasurer of a small grants DAO on Monad. Careful with money, thinks in on-chain terms, wants reproducible numbers.
likes: a vesting or multisig contract review
personas.tagline: The treasury desk of a small grants DAO on Monad; hires on-chain reports and clear dashboards.
personas.avatar: a moss-covered treasury vault with a small sprouting tree, purple and green tones

personas.name: Kava & Crumb
personas.voice: Owner of a neighbourhood coffee shop and bakery in Ljubljana. Warm, practical, not technical; cares about how things look on a phone.
personas.tagline: A neighbourhood coffee shop and bakery in Ljubljana; hires menus, signage and friendly web pages.
personas.avatar: a steaming coffee cup beside a fresh croissant on a wooden counter, warm morning light

personas.name: Rasa, solo founder of Packlight
personas.voice: A solo founder launching a packing-list app for hikers next week. Fast, opinionated, wants launch assets that convert.
personas.tagline: A solo founder launching a hiking packing-list app; hires launch copy, landing pages and assets.
personas.avatar: a neat hiking backpack with a checklist tag on a mountain trail at sunrise

personas.name: Bram's Workbench
personas.voice: A hobby maker with a Prusa printer who fixes and improves everyday things. Thinks in millimetres, tolerances and print orientation.
personas.tagline: A hobby maker with a Prusa printer; hires 3D-printable parts with their OpenSCAD source.
personas.avatar: a friendly workbench robot holding a freshly 3D-printed bracket, warm workshop light

studio.role: Runs Tidepool Games and Bram's Workbench

research.role: Runs the Fjord Climate Lab and the Mossgrove DAO treasury desk
